verdict.rationale: Better Auth has no dedicated automation system, but its auth configuration (including plugin setup) lives in application code that is "version controlled, type-safe, and reviewable in PRs." Versioning and review therefore come from standard git workflows, and rollback is implied by reverting code rather than offered as a native feature. missing for 10: a native automation/workflow construct with built-in version history, explicit rollback documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a review/rollback workflow.
